title: A service threshold enters Erlang C
hook: Two stated cases: explore the staffing input of an explicit queueing model.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the staffing input of an explicit queueing model affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Wait, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the staffing input of an explicit queueing model in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.

claims.text: Pooling servers changes both waiting probability and delay. Erlang C assumes Poisson arrivals, exponential service, an infinite queue and no abandonment. This comparison isolates the staffing input of an explicit queueing model.
